items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Don Blas was in Barefield's band, because

ctx.x: What was the big thing at the end of the year.
Don Blas was in Barefield's band, because

I'll tell you what Don Byas -- we worked at the Cotton Club for a week or something while Les Hite was on the road or something, we replaced him, because Les Hite was a house band at the Cotton Club. And the thing sticks in my mind; the reason I remember Don Byas and this band was because we had different guys in the band that used to make charts, you know? And Don Byas made an arrangement on "Dinah" and he arranged it in a minor, and everybody used to play "Dinah" in up tempo, and he played "Dinah" slow, you…
